column13: Provided are bispecific and multi-specific antibodies that target both claudin 18.2 (CLDN18.2) and 4-1BB. These antibodies, in the absence of CLDN18.2-expressing cells, can bind to 4-1BB but are unable to activate 4-1BB signaling.
